title: Clyra traceability: headline, recession, evidence, signature

scenes.name: Hero
scenes.lead: A pointer-responsive, continuously rotating Möbius continuity ribbon leads the hero. Typography and actions remain DOM.
scenes.fallback: Calm mode restores original sign-in; no custom cursor.

scenes.name: Problem
scenes.lead: Native-scroll horizontal word relay carries records into the product explanation.

scenes.name: Headline
scenes.lead: Every change. Still traceable. fills the frame; illustrations remain hidden.

scenes.name: Recede
scenes.lead: Headline scales back and fades. Evidence arrival overlaps its final 10% of progress.

scenes.name: Evidence
scenes.lead: Linked cards zoom to their final upright composition.

scenes.name: Signature
scenes.lead: The mark draws only after the cards land.

scenes.name: Release
scenes.lead: Hold the completed evidence composition, then native scroll releases the stage.

scenes.name: Explore
scenes.lead: Interactive Source/Findings/Summary illustration with explicit descriptions and tab semantics.

scenes.name: Handover
scenes.lead: Large closing typography leads to the real sign-in form.

notes: Owner-requested bolder cinematic visual world. One looping lead ribbon per viewport, one ambient workspace ticker. Easy reading turns both off globally; reduced motion takes priority. Native scrolling and real clinical evidence remain independent. Mobile distills the rig to static stacked content.
